cohort: The study included pregnant women over 35 years old with a history of caesarean sections, placenta previa, or multiple pregnancies.
finding: Ultrasound demonstrated good diagnostic accuracy for morbidly adherent placenta, with a sensitivity of 82.09%, specificity of 76.92%, positive predictive value of 92.44%, negative predictive value of 55.56%, and overall accuracy of 80.92% when using histopathology as the gold standard.
gest_age: 37.94+/- 1.07 weeks (mean maternal gestational age at time of diagnosis)
